PRICKLE PATCH - a RetroStone VC game for Windows
(c) 2026 Pierre-Louis Boyer (8BCraft). Code MIT, art/music/sound CC BY-NC-SA 4.0: see LICENSE-pricklepatch.txt.

A little hedgehog keeps the vegetable patch: slugs, beetles, ants, wasps and crows come from every side, more
and more of them. You only walk: your garden tools work by themselves. Pests leave gems, gems bring levels,
each level a new tool or an upgrade. Survive 15 minutes and chase off the Crow King to save the garden. Coins
buy boosts in the garden shed, and two more gardeners: a tortoise and a hen.

Run PricklePatch.exe. No installation needed (SDL2 is built in).

Controls                  Gamepad (SNES layout)      Keyboard
  walk                      D-pad                      arrows
  a level-up's choice       Up / Down, then A          arrows, then X
  pause / resume            Start or Select            Enter, Backspace or Esc
  paused: back to title     B (the run is kept)        Z
  title: the gardener       Left / Right               arrows
  title: the garden shed    X, Y or Select             V, C or Backspace
  title: a new run          B (when a run is kept)     Z
The mouse is a finger: hold the left button anywhere and drag to walk.

F11 or Alt+Enter: fullscreen. F12: screenshot. Close the window to quit.
Options: PricklePatch.exe --scale 4 --fullscreen
The best run, the coins and the boosts are saved in pricklepatch.srm next to the exe.
